# PRICEB.TC

> PRICEB.TC is a simple, timestamped source for the current Bitcoin price, readable by humans, websites and software agents.

## Current Bitcoin price

- [Bitcoin price now](https://priceb.tc/): Current observation with source, currency and timestamp.
- [Current BTC/USD JSON](https://priceb.tc/api/price?currency=USD): Machine-readable observation.
- [Bitcoin Price API](https://priceb.tc/api): Fields, freshness and errors.
- [Bitcoin price Markdown](https://priceb.tc/bitcoin-price.md): Timestamped observation as text.

## Source and freshness

BTC/USD observations come from Coinbase Exchange (market BTC-USD), not a single global Bitcoin price. Other currencies use indicative daily FX conversions.
Always use marketTimestamp (ISO 8601) to determine observation age. receivedAt is the service reception time. status describes live/stale data; an unavailable snapshot returns HTTP 503. Preserve the source, currency, timestamp and status when quoting a price.
The API preserves source as the string "coinbase"; sourceDetails names the exchange and market. Decimal prices remain strings for precision; change24h is a number. Do not cache observations indefinitely.

## Documentation

- [Price source and updates](https://priceb.tc/bitcoin-price-updates): Methodology and freshness.
- [Website widget guide](https://priceb.tc/bitcoin-price-widget): Embed setup.
- [OBS overlay guide](https://priceb.tc/bitcoin-obs-overlay): Broadcast setup.
- [Widget Studio](https://priceb.tc/studio): Configure a widget or overlay.
